findings.title: js-yaml 4.3.1 has high-severity ReDoS vulnerability (GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh)
findings.detail: frontend/package-lock.json pinned js-yaml at 4.3.1 (dev transitive dep). CVE range >=4.0.0 <4.3.2: maxTotalMergeKeys does not limit CPU use for empty merge sources (CVSS 7.5). Fix applied: bumped to 4.3.2 via npm audit fix. Lint and build verified. Branch pushed: claude-maintenance/2026-09-10-fix-js-yaml. PR creation blocked: GH_TOKEN is read-only (lacks createPullRequest permission).
findings.suggested_fix: Open a PR from branch claude-maintenance/2026-09-10-fix-js-yaml → main (fix already committed and pushed)

findings.title: wrangler/miniflare pulls in sharp <0.35.4 with heap-buffer-overflow (GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c)
findings.detail: worker/package-lock.json: wrangler >= 4.16.0 bundles miniflare which bundles sharp <0.35.4 (libheif heap-buffer-overflow, high severity). npm audit reports the fix version as wrangler 4.15.2, which is a downgrade from current ^4.37.0 — unsafe to apply automatically. This is a dev-tool dependency that affects CI/local dev environments only, not the deployed Worker. Recommend monitoring for a wrangler patch that upgrades the bundled sharp to >=0.35.4.
findings.suggested_fix: Monitor wrangler releases for a build that bundles sharp >=0.35.4; do not downgrade wrangler

findings.title: React 18.2.0 → 19.3.0 (one major version behind)
findings.detail: frontend/package.json specifies react and react-dom ^18.2.0; latest is 19.3.0. Major version bump requires manual migration (new JSX transform, Concurrent Features API changes, breaking changes in StrictMode). Not suitable for automated fix.
findings.suggested_fix: Manually upgrade react and react-dom to ^19 following the React 19 migration guide

fix_note: Fix for finding[0] was applied, linted, built, and pushed to branch claude-maintenance/2026-09-10-fix-js-yaml, but PR creation failed: GH_TOKEN environment variable is read-only (GraphQL createPullRequest denied). A maintainer can open the PR manually from that branch.
